access_note: The public Mendeley page names version one, states CC BY 4.0 and lists data-generation scripts. Its API returned 401, so file names and sizes used here come from the describing MDPI article. No CSV, script or Excel model was downloaded or executed.
description: Montanuniversität Leoben publishes approximately three million Monte Carlo results for a methanol-to-jet synthetic aviation fuel pathway. The Mendeley record names technical, operating and economic inputs, with net production cost per kilogram of jet fuel as the main output. The describing Data article says the release includes a 264 MB CSV, smaller one-million, 100,000 and 10,000-row samples, variable descriptions and Python processing scripts. The results come from an Aspen Plus V14 process model coupled to an external techno-economic calculation. Its coverage is a generic production pathway, not a set of identified plants or regions. Energy and aviation modellers can reuse the rows for uncertainty or sensitivity analysis, compare cost assumptions, or train a surrogate for fuel-production planning. The public deposit states CC BY 4.0. These are generated scenario results, not measured plant performance. The public page does not establish that the underlying Aspen or Excel models are fully included, so independent reproduction of every run is uncertain. The files and scripts were not downloaded or executed. The catalogued OFFBEAT fuel-performance model concerns a different resource and is only a related fuel-simulation reference.
name: Monte carlo dataset for techno-economic assessment of sustainable aviation fuel production via methanol-to-jet
